lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: Good evening, fight fans, and welcome to the mock-mode main event!

lines.speaker: color_commentator
lines.text: According to legend, nobody leaves this arena without a story.

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: In the red corner: a fighter with something to prove!

lines.speaker: announcer
lines.text: And in the blue corner: a fighter who has heard that before!

lines.speaker: color_commentator
lines.text: The science is in. The snacks are out. Let's fight!
